games.desc:
SERVER RESET = UPDATE

DIOKOPHOBIA is a Survival Game where SEVEN players are selected as HUNTERS, and TWO are selected as the SURVIVORS 👀

HOW TO PLAY:
- As a HUNTER, chase down the current Survivor(s) and TAG them to swap places 🔄
- Activate all of the Buttons HIDDEN around the map 🚨
- As the SURVIVOR(s), dodge, weave and avoid the HUNTERS by ANY MEANS necessary 🏃
- Be the last SURVIVOR(s) STANDING after all buttons are ACTIVATED to WIN ⭐
